extracted.intended_audience: Applicants to the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund postdoctoral fellowship (2021 application cycle)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and submission requirements for applicants to the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund postdoctoral fellowship, describing required documents, formatting rules, deadlines, and procedures for sponsor/referee letters and publication listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline and finality
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadline date for this application period is February 1st, 2021 at 11:59 PM EST
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please review your application before final submission. No changes will be made to the application once it is submitted. When you have successfully submitted your application an email will be sent to you stating that you have successfully submitted your application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete every section of the application
rubrics_metrics.description: Each section of the application is to be completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All sections must be filled; incomplete applications are not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name format in Section 1
rubrics_metrics.description: Please make sure that in Section 1 – Personal information you enter your Last name and then First name
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter last name, then first name exactly, because the Sponsor and Referee emails use that information to identify you. Ensure consistency to avoid misidentification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor letter required
rubrics_metrics.description: You will need to have a Sponsor letter. An email will be sent to the Sponsor with instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make sure you fill your name out in Section 1 (last name, first name). The deadline for Sponsor letters is February 12, 2021. Sponsor should not be listed as one of the three references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three references required (including PhD advisor)
rubrics_metrics.description: You will need to have 3 References. Your PhD advisor and 2 other letters; do not include your Sponsor as a reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An email will be sent to the referees with instructions. Please make sure your name has been completed in Section 1 (last name, first name). The deadline for these letters is February 12, 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor and referee notification and resend procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: All Sponsor and Referees will be notified by email through the application process. The email they receive will outline the information that is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ask sponsors/referees to check spam/junk folders if they have not received the email. To resend a request, email jccfund@yale.edu with subject 'Re-Send request for applicant name and referee or sponsor name' and include the Sponsor or referee’s name and their email address in the body; the Fund will resend the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal statement formatting and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal statement: 2 pages of text font no smaller than 12 and margin >= .25
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 8-1/2 X 11” paper. Proposal statement is limited to 2 pages; ensure font size is at least 12 and margins are at least 0.25 inches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures upload (optional) formatting and length
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Figures should be on 8-1/2 X 11” paper and limited to 2 pages total; optional to include.

rubrics_metrics.name: References section formatting and length
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References must fit on one 8-1/2 X 11” page and contain no more than 40 citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication listing format and link rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Publications: Please include a link to your top 3 publications. Then list the remainder of your publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified publication format: Author(s), Publication year, Title, Publication or Journal name, Volume number, Page number range. Omit the link after the third publication. Example given in guidelines. If publications change during the application process (e.g., accepted after submission), email jccfund@yale.edu with subject '(your name) and Publication update' so the Fund can send updated information to reviewers. If you have trouble fitting publications on one page, use 'et al' for publications with more than 3 authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication format example
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the following format for all publications: Author(s), Publication year, Title, Publication or Journal name, Volume number, Page number range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided in guidelines (Goellner EM, Grimme B, ... 2011; Overcoming Temozolomide Resistance ... Cancer Research. 71:2308- ... Link ...). Omit links after the top three publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research experience narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Experience: this is to be in narrative form (do not list dates and positions only)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start with your thesis work, and you can list other experience that you feel is relevant. Please keep to one page, using the same formatting as the proposal statement (8-1/2 X 11”, font no smaller than 12, margin >= .25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature page requirements and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Signature page with applicant signature, department head signature and grants/contract/fiscal office signature is a separate document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page is at the end of the application but is not submitted with the application. A copy of this form is available on the jccfund.org website under 'Fellowship Information' → 'Important Dates and Documents'. The deadline for submission of the Signature page is February 12, 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: No post-submission edits; update procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Once your application is submitted there will be no changes allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any updates that you feel are relevant are to be emailed to the Fund at jccfund@yale.edu.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission confirmation email
rubrics_metrics.description: When you have successfully submitted your application an email will be sent to you stating that you have successfully submitted your application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Retain this confirmation; it is the record of successful submission.
